entities.summary: HD 128311 c is an exoplanet located approximately 54 light-years away in the constellation of Boötes. This planet orbits in an eccentric orbit at 1.74 AU from its star. The planet has a minimum mass of 3.22 MJ, and astrometric observations in 2014 revealed its true mass to be 3.789 MJ.
